data.one_liner: Consistent, high-performance, and reproducible random number generators in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides classes implementing various pseudorandom number generators with the same API as dart:math's Random. It ensures bit-accurate numbers across platforms and supports reproducibility and high-quality randomness for simulations.
use_when: You need reproducible random sequences for testing or simulations
You need consistent random results across different native platforms
You want faster alternatives to dart:math's Random
avoid_when: Your target platform is JavaScript and you need to use 64-bit generators that are unsupported there
You are looking for cryptographically secure random numbers
strengths: Multiple well-known RNG algorithms available (Xorshift, Xoshiro, Splitmix, Mulberry)
Faster execution times compared to standard dart:math Random in benchmarks
weaknesses: Some 64-bit generators are unsupported on JavaScript and will throw an UnsupportedError
